_notes: The screens shown when the game starts, before the title. One card each, in order.
lines: the text, top to bottom. size: text size. font: 'sans' (clean capitals) or 'hand' (handwriting). alpha: 0..1, how bright.
icon: 'shutter' draws the saving icon above the text.
seconds: how long it stays. min_seconds: how long before a press can skip it.
A press skips one card. Esc (or Start) skips them all. The studio name and the rating are placeholders: fill them in when they are decided.

lines.text: Below the Pass is a work of fiction. Any resemblance to real people, places or events is coincidental.
It contains death, violence, alcohol and smoking.
Some scenes have camera flashes and sudden bright light. You can soften them in Settings.
Please don't quit while this icon is turning.
